Partly built

Small law firm

A client will write on WhatsApp, book a consult, and a licensed person will deliver the work with the money held until it is verified.

Partly built. Some of the steps below exist today and the rest are still to come. The lists at the bottom show which.

How it runs

  1. EventA client via WhatsAppWrites to the firm's number.
  2. PlanThe assistant via modelOffers a consult, a zero-price step, and checks for conflicts against the firm's client facts.
  3. PlanA licensed person via person insideTakes the deliverable that only a licensed person may take, under the country's rules.
  4. ProposalThe firm no tool neededSets the price; the client approves; the money is held.
  5. ReceiptThe work via a personSettled when verified.
What you get
Starts withA firm and its clients
StatusPartly built
The consult, the work delivered, the price held and settled.

What it keeps to

  • Only a licensed person can take a regulated deliverable.
  • Client facts stay inside the firm's workspace.
  • Money moves only after a proposal is approved.
